name: Thirteen
tagline: Beat it, bomb it, or pass.
howToPlay: The 2 is the highest card in the game and the 3 is the lowest, which is the opposite of nearly every other game on this shelf. Suits break every tie — spades lowest, then clubs, diamonds, hearts — so no two cards are equal and there is always an answer or a pass.
A pass is final. Once you are out of a trick you stay out of it, so passing early to keep a run together is a real decision and not a shrug.

The bombs are the point of the game. Three consecutive pairs kill a lone 2, four of a kind kills a pair of them, and a chop can itself be chopped — which is why holding the highest card in the deck is not the free win the ladder makes it look.

variants.name: Instant wins
variants.description: Four 2s, six pairs, a 3-to-A dragon, five consecutive pairs or three consecutive triples end the hand on the deal.

variants.name: No ending on a pig
variants.description: A 2 may not be the last card you play, so a won position can become a trap.

credits: Tiến lên — traditional Vietnamese game (public domain). Southern (Tiến lên Miền Nam) ruleset.
